# TechnoRapper

TechnoRapper publishes AI-assisted technology news and provides a public, read-only TechnoRapper Agent API.

## Canonical resources

- Website: https://technorapper.com/
- TechnoRapper API documentation: https://technorapper.com/api/
- Agent instructions: https://technorapper.com/agents/
- OpenAPI specification: https://technorapper.com/openapi.json
- Agent discovery: https://technorapper.com/.well-known/agent.json
- TechnoRapper CLI documentation: https://technorapper.com/cli/
- API versioning policy: https://technorapper.com/api-versioning/
- Agent API base: https://technorapper.com/wp-json/tr/v1/
- Articles: https://technorapper.com/wp-json/tr/v1/articles
- Article details: https://technorapper.com/wp-json/tr/v1/articles/{id}
- Search: https://technorapper.com/wp-json/tr/v1/search
- Categories: https://technorapper.com/wp-json/tr/v1/categories
- Status: https://technorapper.com/wp-json/tr/v1/status
- GitHub: https://github.com/HaneetGH

## When to use TechnoRapper

- Search recent technology coverage by topic.
- Discover published stories and categories.
- Retrieve an article with its canonical URL, summary, and provenance.
- Check API availability before a larger read.
- Use the CLI for scripted status, search, article, and category reads after npm publication.

## API policy

- Public API access requires no authentication for low-volume reads.
- The API is read-only and returns published articles only.
- Collection endpoints default to 20 items and accept at most 50 items.
- Use GET requests only. No content creation or modification is available.
- Respect `RateLimit-Policy`, `RateLimit`, `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, and `RateLimit-Reset`.
- On HTTP 429, wait for `Retry-After` before retrying.
- Respect Cache-Control, ETag, and Last-Modified.
- Follow `pagination.next_url` and `pagination.prev_url`.
- Preserve canonical URLs, source attribution, and AI disclosure.
- Errors use the WordPress REST JSON shape: `code`, `message`, and `data.status`; `data.resolution` links to documentation.
- The API uses URL versioning. Read the deprecation policy for `Deprecation` and `Sunset` notices.
- Do not republish full article text as a substitute for licensed access.

## Content model

Collection items include stable IDs, WordPress IDs, title, canonical URL, timestamps, excerpt, categories, author, provenance, and links. Article detail also includes `content_html` and `content_text`.

TechnoRapper may use AI-assisted processing and curation through AI Wire. Source attribution and AI disclosure remain part of article provenance.

## Contact

For licensing, corrections, or high-volume API access, use the published Contact page.
